title: Real equities (2010-2025)
blurb: The same swarm on real prices of 117 large caps. The universe is survivors only, which is a flaw.
honesty: Skeptic reduces false discoveries and quantifies uncertainty. It does not prove truth.
Null-world validity depends on the null generator preserving the data's real structure (assumptions are listed per generator).
Backtests are not forecasts. Nothing here is trading advice.

Built on known methods: White's Reality Check, Hansen's SPA, Deflated Sharpe, Benjamini-Hochberg, alpha-investing (Foster & Stine). Our contribution is applying them to an autonomous agent's own search as one integrated, measurable system.
